overview.title: Overview
overview.noLocation: Choose a location at the top to see its setup.
overview.activateHint: Operation can be activated once all items are done.
overview.activateNoPermission: Only people with permission to manage the location can activate operation.

tax.title: VAT (MWST)
tax.description: Tax categories, rates and rules with validity dates.
tax.frozenText: Every item sold stores the rate that applied at the time of sale. New rates and rules only affect sales from their start date, without a software update.
tax.readOnly: Only people with permission to manage VAT can make changes.
tax.matrixHint: Rate per tax category and consumption type on {date}.
tax.categoriesHint: The label appears in the backoffice and in reports. The key stays the same.
tax.label: Label
tax.ratesHint: A rate applies from its start date. Periods of the same rate type must not overlap.
tax.rulesHint: Which rate type applies to a tax category, depending on the consumption type.
tax.rateInvalid: Please enter a percentage between 0 and 100 with at most two decimal places.
tax.validToHint: Leave empty for no end date.
tax.closePreviousRate: End the current rate on the previous day
tax.closePreviousRule: End the current rule on the previous day
tax.closePreviousHint: The entry valid today ends on the day before the new start date.
tax.overlap: The period overlaps with an existing entry. Choose another start date or end the current entry on the previous day.

customers.title: Guests
customers.description: Guest data only with consent (Swiss FADP).
customers.noPermission: You don’t have permission to manage guests.
customers.resultsLimited: At most {count} guests are shown. Refine your search.
customers.name: Name
customers.contactRequired: Please enter a phone number or email.
customers.allergiesHint: Only what the guest states. Doesn’t replace asking when taking the order.
customers.tagsHint: Separate with commas, for example regular, terrace
customers.consentRequired: Without consent, the guest can’t be saved.
customers.consentTextHint: Exactly the text the guest agreed to. It is stored unchanged.
customers.consentDefaultText: I agree that the restaurant may store my name and contact details in order to handle reservations and orders. I can request information about my data, a copy of it or its deletion at any time.
customers.consentMarketingText: I agree that the restaurant may inform me about offers and events by email or text message. I can withdraw this consent at any time.
customers.duplicate: A guest with this phone number or email already exists.
customers.privacyHint: At the guest’s request (Swiss FADP): hand over all stored data or irreversibly anonymise it.
customers.exported: Export created. It is recorded in the audit log.
customers.anonymizeReasonHint: For example “Request by email of 06.10.2026”. Appears in the audit log.
customers.anonymizeText: Name, phone, email, notes, allergies and tags are deleted and all consents are ended. This can’t be undone. Sales and receipts are kept unchanged.
customers.anonymizeWarning: Can’t be undone. Sales and receipts are kept.
customers.anonymizedNotice: This guest was anonymised on {date}. Their data can no longer be changed.
customers.anonymizeNoPermission: Only people with the corresponding permission can anonymise guests.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: All sensitive operations, newest first. Entries can be neither changed nor deleted.
audit.noPermission: You don’t have permission to view the audit log.

supportAccess.title: Support access
supportAccess.description: DINOLABS support only opens your organisation with your permission and only for a limited time.
supportAccess.noPermission: Only owners and administrators can manage support access.
supportAccess.how1: You allow DINOLABS support access for a fixed period, for example during a support case.
supportAccess.how2: While access is active, support can view and change your setup. Every action appears in the audit log marked “DINOLABS support”.
supportAccess.how3: You can revoke access at any time. It ends automatically when it expires.
supportAccess.reasonHint: For example a ticket number or the issue. Appears in the audit log.
supportAccess.revokeText: Support loses access immediately. You can grant new access later.
supportAccess.onlyUsers: Only people in your organisation can grant and revoke access, not support itself.

supportConsole.title: DINOLABS Support
supportConsole.description: Restaurants on the platform. You can only open an organisation with valid access granted by its owner.
supportConsole.name: Organisation
supportConsole.noGrant: The organisation hasn’t granted valid support access.
supportConsole.noLocation: This organisation has no location yet.
supportConsole.insideTitle: You are currently working in an organisation
supportConsole.insideText: Return to the backoffice or leave the organisation before opening another one.
supportConsole.staffError: Your support account is unknown or deactivated.

onboarding.title: Create new restaurant
onboarding.description: Organisation, first location and the owner’s account. Roles and Swiss VAT rules are set up automatically.
onboarding.languagesMissingDefault: The languages must include the main language.
onboarding.emailTaken: This email already belongs to an account.
onboarding.resultText: Pass these sign-in details on to the owner securely. They must set their own password when signing in for the first time.
onboarding.passwordOnce: The password is shown only now and can’t be retrieved later.
onboarding.copyFailed: Copying isn’t possible. Please select the password manually.
onboarding.nextSteps: Before you can open the organisation, the owner must grant access under Support access.
